page_title: AST 1-0 FUL | Aston Villa v Fulham 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Adama Traore (Fulham) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Willian (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+7' It's a throw-in for Fulham.
90+6' Robert Jones interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Raul Jimenez (Fulham).

90+5' What a chance that is! Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the crossbar!
90+3' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Adama Traore (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
87' An accurate cross picks out Raul Jimenez (Fulham) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
86' Marco Silva is stunned as referee Robert Jones shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
85' Adama Traore (Fulham) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Youri Tielemans trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
82' It doesn’t look good for Harrison Reed (Fulham); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
82' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) tries to find Donyell Malen, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
80' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) meets a cross inside the box, but Bernd Leno wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
79' A pass by Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
76' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fulham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Willian (Fulham) replacing Alex Iwobi.
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Harrison Reed (Fulham) coming on for Sander Berge.
74' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
73' Ball possession – 56:44.
71' Here is a change. Ian Maatsen is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ollie Watkins departs the field of play to be replaced by Donyell Malen (Aston Villa).

70' CHANCE! Ollie Watkins finds Pau Torres (Aston Villa) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
70' The free kick is taken by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa), but ball is cleared.
68' Aston Villa will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Timothy Castagne (Fulham) replaces Kenny Tete.
67' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Adama Traore (Fulham) replaces Harry Wilson.
66' Robert Jones blows his whistle. Calvin Bassey (Fulham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
66' Sander Berge (Fulham) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
65' Harry Wilson (Fulham) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Emiliano Martinez makes a comfortable save.
63' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) unleashes a first-time shot from the edge of the box which goes a few yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
63' The resulting corner from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
62' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
62' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Bernd Leno makes a save.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for John McGinn.
60' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Marco Asensio is replaced by Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa).
59' The game is interrupted. Calvin Bassey (Fulham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
59' The corner from Harry Wilson (Fulham) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez.
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is replacing Ryan Sessegnon.
56' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by John McGinn (Aston Villa) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
55' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman signals a throw-in for Aston Villa.
54' Harry Wilson (Fulham) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez is prepared to thwart his effort.
54' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
52' Kenny Tete (Fulham) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
50' The Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Robert Jones rules it out for a handball.

48' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kenny Tete (Fulham).
47' The ball crosses the sideline and it is going to be a throw-in.
47' John McGinn (Aston Villa) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
46' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tries to find Ollie Watkins, but he puts too much power on the pass.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' Emiliano Martinez pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Alex Iwobi (Fulham) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the right post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' A rebound falls at the feet of Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa), whose promising strike from long range flies a few inches wide of the right post! What a great effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
44' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
44' Aston Villa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
41' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
41' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) is penalised for holding. Robert Jones signals a set piece. Free kick. Fulham will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
39' Half-chance! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) plays a pass into the box, but Bernd Leno reacts well to snuff out the attack.
38' The ball is cleared after Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) sends a long ball in, but Bernd Leno comfortably gathers the ball.
35' Kenny Tete (Fulham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Aston Villa are awarded the free kick.
34' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
33' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
32' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
31' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
28' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will take a throw-in.
26' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
26' Rough tackle by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fulham.
24' The ball goes out of play and it is going to be a throw-in.
22' Sander Berge (Fulham) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
20' Bernd Leno displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
18' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Aston Villa.
17' Aston Villa are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
14' Fulham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

12' 1 - 0 Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:0.
12' There's an opportunity for John McGinn (Aston Villa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

12' What a great touch by Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Aston Villa have a corner.
12' A cross by Antonee Robinson (Fulham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
11' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Fulham.
10' It looks like Matty Cash (Aston Villa) saw red with that tackle. Robert Jones won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
10' The ball is behind the touchline and Fulham will take a throw-in.
8' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
8' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) attempts to find Ollie Watkins, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
8' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

7' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The linesman makes the right call and Aston Villa will have a corner.
6' Robert Jones blows for a foul after Antonee Robinson (Fulham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
5' The corner from John McGinn (Aston Villa) is hurriedly cleared.
3' The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
2' An attempted cross from Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is cleared.
1' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) sends a long ball in, but Emiliano Martinez comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The match has just started.
Fulham will kick-off.
Robert Jones will officiate today.
